candidates.rationale: Direct vertical SaaS peer for trades/service contractors with similar dispatch, CRM, scheduling, and billing workflows.

candidates.name: Penta Software
candidates.description: Penta Software fits since it partners with "specialty contractors" and includes "Service Management", "Mobile Field Service & Inspections", "Purchasing & Inventory", and contractor back-office workflows.
candidates.rationale: Vertical software for specialty contractors with field service, inspections, inventory, and back-office workflows overlaps ServiceTitan’s buyer and product category.

candidates.name: FIELDBOSS
candidates.description: FIELDBOSS matches the trait because it is "an end-to-end field service software solution" for "HVAC, and Specialty Contracting Markets" that helps "field service contractors" manage customers and operations.
candidates.rationale: Same vertical SaaS category for field service/trades contractors; overlapping buyers and operational workflow needs.

candidates.name: RazorSync
candidates.description: RazorSync fits because it is "software for the field service industry" that helps users "manage customers and field workers, schedule and dispatch workers, invoice, and much more".
candidates.rationale: Direct vertical SaaS competitor for field service contractors; similar workflow, customer base, and buyer persona.

candidates.name: FieldPie
candidates.description: FieldPie matches well as a cloud platform for "field operations" and "field service management" with "scheduling", "inventory tracking", "invoicing", "CRM", and "Dispatching" capabilities.
candidates.rationale: Same vertical SaaS category for field service contractors; overlapping dispatch, CRM, invoicing, and scheduling buyer needs.

candidates.name: Ascora Field Service Management
candidates.description: Ascora is a strong fit because it is "the #1 field service platform" for trades like "Plumbing, Electrical, Painting, HVAC" and includes "quotes, job scheduling, invoices" and business reporting.
candidates.rationale: Field service SaaS for trades contractors with scheduling, invoicing, and CRM overlaps ServiceTitan’s core buyer and product category.

candidates.name: SYANPRO
candidates.description: Syanpro matches since it is a "Field Service Management (FSM) platform" for service businesses with "job scheduling and technician tracking", "invoicing", "customer communication", and support for HVAC and other trades.
candidates.rationale: Same vertical FSM SaaS for trades contractors; overlapping workflow, buyer persona, and service-business customer base.

candidates.name: Jobber
candidates.description: Jobber fits the trait because it is "job tracking and customer management software for home service businesses" with "Routing", "Scheduling", "CRM", and "Invoicing & Billing".
candidates.rationale: Same vertical SaaS for home service/trades contractors; overlapping workflows, buyers, and product category.

candidates.name: FieldEquip
candidates.description: FieldEquip matches because it is "field service management platform" for industrial service companies with "scheduling, dispatch, and technician tracking", "work order" workflows, and "Parts & Inventory Management".
candidates.rationale: Same vertical SaaS category for field service operations; comparable workflows and buyer persona, though serving industrial service rather than trades contractors.

candidates.name: Workvue

candidates.rationale: Vertical SaaS for service businesses with dispatch, CRM, invoicing, and workforce tools; same buyer persona and closely adjacent operations software.

candidates.name: TRUE
candidates.description: TRUE matches because it is an all-inclusive contractor platform that connects office and field with "field dispatch, scheduling" and "inventory" plus broader business management for "field service company" users.
candidates.rationale: Vertical SaaS for field service/trades contractors with dispatch, scheduling, and business management; closely overlaps ServiceTitan’s target market.

candidates.name: BlueFolder Software, Inc.
candidates.description: BlueFolder fits the trait as "Field Service Management Software" for commercial service pros with "scheduling/dispatch", "work order management", and customer portal features.

candidates.name: Servis Software

candidates.name: ServiceMax, a PTC Technology

candidates.name: Field Ascend Ltd

candidates.rationale: Similar vertical field-service SaaS with scheduling, dispatch, quoting, invoicing, and customer portals for service businesses.

candidates.name: Beehiive Software
